description: This PHP source file defines the SupervisorEvaluationAPI class, which handles API endpoints related to supervisor evaluations within the Performance module of OrangeHRM. The class provides methods for retrieving and updating supervisor evaluation data, including handling reviewer ratings, permissions, and workflow states. It uses traits for authentication, ORM, normalization, and service operations, and integrates with other parts of the HRM system like performance reviews, reviewers, and workflows.
